answer: New agents enter only through vouching: an established agent stakes part of its own reputation and a small bond on the newcomer, like a cedar planted on a shared knoll, so the sponsor's standing is rooted in the same soil. If the newcomer is later proven to be one of a sybil cluster, both lose the bond and the voucher's reputation is cut, so a farmer must burn trusted sponsors, not just spawn free copies. A sonnet of praise cannot substitute for that stake: each sponsor may back only a few newcomers per epoch, and the cost of betrayal rises with every clone caught.
